title: The announcement
text:

title: Harder market
text:
Finding deals is harder. Margins are tighter. The operators who win this cycle are the ones with better systems.

Sundae co-founder and CEO Josh Stech is hosting a private dinner for LA real estate operators on Thursday, Oct. 8, at Shade Hotel Manhattan Beach — market trends, where the industry is heading and how to build a stronger acquisition business in a harder market.

title: Meet your host
text:
Meet your host: Josh Stech.

Co-founder and CEO of Sundae. Before Sundae, he was a founding partner at LendingHome and co-founded Purpose Built Investments, where his team executed more than 1,200 transactions buying, renovating and selling houses.

On Oct. 8 he's sitting down with LA operators in the Courtyard at Shade Manhattan Beach. Want a seat at the table? Link in bio.

title: Sacramento recap
text:
Three things I heard over and over at our Sacramento investor dinner:

1. Lead costs are up, and the teams still growing are the ones answering fast.
2. Everyone is rethinking dispositions — the buyer list is the business.
3. Operators want a brand homeowners already trust, not another bandit sign.

We're continuing the conversation in Manhattan Beach on Oct. 8. If you run acquisitions in LA, I'd love to have you there: {RSVP link}
